note: OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Verified = the /models endpoint responded during maintenance. Free models change often; treat them as a hint, not a promise.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.notes: The reference implementation. gpt-4o-mini is the cheap default.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.notes: One key for 200+ models. Many models have a ':free' variant; the model list shows them.

providers.name: Groq
providers.notes: Very fast inference, generous free tier, rate-limited. Model ids change - pick from the live list.

providers.name: Together AI
providers.notes: Good open-weight model selection, free tier on signup.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.notes: Very cheap, strong reasoning. deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner.

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.notes: Fast cloud inference, free tier available.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.notes: Huge open-model catalogue, free rate-limited tier.

providers.name: AIHubMix
providers.notes: Aggregator with many free tiers. Verified: 669 models listed.

providers.name: OpenCode Zen
providers.notes: OpenCode's own gateway. Reasoning effort is set with AI_REASONING_EFFORT.

providers.name: Google Gemini (OpenAI-compatible)
providers.notes: Gemini's OpenAI-compatible layer. Model ids look like 'gemini-2.0-flash'.

providers.name: Ollama (local)
providers.notes: Runs on your machine. No key needed; leave AI_API_KEY empty.

providers.name: vLLM (self-hosted)
providers.notes: Point this at your own vLLM server. Change the host/port to taste.
